title: Ruuhu torraaɗo e maayo Niil
intro: E jamaanu tooñannge mawnge, nde jom doole en laami leydi ndii e tooñanngeeji timmuɗi, ruuhu gooto suɓii laawol iimanaagal e dow wellitaare laamɗo. Ndee ɗoo limre hoɗii e ɓernde laamu kono tawi goonga e nelal annabi lesɗikiniiɗo. Jahgol maɓɓe maa won jannde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi e muñal, e sadak, e hoolaare nde ustataako. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo neɗɗo teskinɗo ɓurɗo yiɗde weltaare Alla e darnde aduna?
clues: Miɗo hoɗi e galle laamorɗo doole mawɗe, kono ɓernde am heɓi goonga e nulal lesɗikiniiɗo.
Mi suɓii ko rewde laawol Muusaa, miɗo anndi batte ɗe njogori-mi dañde.
Miɗo resndi jom doole ɓurɗo doole e jamaanu am, tee mi saliima laamɓe makko fenaande.
Torra am ina tiiɗi, nde tawnoo miɗo ñaawee sabu goongɗinde am e Alla gooto.
Mi meeɗaa ƴattaade e goonɗinal am, hay so tawii mi hawrii e torra ɓurɗo tiiɗde.
Joom am weltiima e muñal am, suɓii kam nokku tedduɗo e nder Aljanna.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Wuuri haa mawni e nder jam

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
